Hi Samantha —

Great to meet on the discovery call last week. To get your team into production smoothly we typically run a 60-minute stakeholder alignment session in week zero to confirm roles, access, and the go-live checklist.

Proposed slots (PST):
- Tue 2026-12-22 10:00–11:00
- Wed 2026-12-23 14:00–15:00

Agenda (tentative):
1) Introductions & success criteria (10m)
2) Access matrix & network checks (15m)
3) Roles & owner assignments for SSO, KMS, and data paths (15m)
4) Implementation timeline & milestones (10m)
5) Next steps & wrap (10m)

Please confirm which slot works and who from Acme should attend (names + emails). I’ve attached a short prework checklist and connectivity instructions — if your infra lead can complete items 1–3 before the session it will speed things up.

Attachments: acme_prework_checklist.pdf (2 pages), connectivity_instructions.md (1 page)

If neither time works, propose two alternatives and we’ll coordinate. Once we lock a time Monica will send the calendar invite and bridge.

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
diego@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

--
